explication: GGA is a Bash code-review CLI. Its documented main workflow reviews staged files against project rules, invokes a configured AI provider, and reports pass/fail details; PR mode reviews full PR changes instead. The README also documents caching and Git-hook use. Source excerpts were unavailable, so relationships below are limited to those explicitly described in the README; implementation details and provider-specific dispatch are not inferred.
